rain_probability.moderate: Rain may affect comfort and trail conditions.
rain_probability.high: Rain may create slippery trails and sustained exposure.
rain_probability.severe: Rain risk may make exposed or long routes unsuitable.

precipitation.moderate: Some trail wetness and reduced comfort are possible.
precipitation.high: Significant trail wetness, drainage issues, and slipping risk are possible.
precipitation.severe: Heavy accumulated rainfall may make the route unsuitable.

apparent_temperature.high: Heat exposure may require a shorter route or earlier timing.
apparent_temperature.severe: Sustained heat may make the hike unsuitable.

wind.high: Balance, branch-fall, and exposed-route risks increase.
wind.severe: Strong wind may make exposed hiking unsuitable.

visibility.moderate: Navigation and route awareness may be affected.
visibility.high: Poor visibility may make route-finding difficult.
visibility.severe: Very poor visibility may make hiking unsuitable.

assumptions: A general-user fitness and mobility baseline was used.
limitations: Official weather alerts and air-quality data were not checked.
agent_task: Use the classified weather evidence, activity profile, timing, and personal constraints to produce one allowed verdict: proceed, adjust, postpone, or insufficient_information. Do not change the supplied weather severities.
